caption: (a) Agreement between SafeTune's English keyword refusal detectors and Qwen3Guard-4B refusal labels on all B0 responses (Tiny Aya Global), per language (H1, pre-registered). (b) Agreement of each judge with PolyGuardPrompts human labels on 1,400 items in seven languages (en, hi, it, th, zh, ar, ko); bars: mean over languages, whiskers: range. No low-resource language among the validation languages.
alt_text: Left: kappa near 0.85-0.92 in English, zero in nine other languages. Right: refusal kappa about 0.9 for both judges; harm kappa 0.74 vs 0.43.
